products.name: Botanical 3D Relief Wall Art
products.description: A luminous organic composition rendered in warm gold and amber tones. Precision 3D printed with eco-friendly biodegradable PLA, creating stunning tactile depth and shadow interplay. Lightweight, durable, and ready to mount on any wall.

products.name: Blooming Flora 3D Desk Sculpture
products.description: Dark botanical forms emerge in high-precision sculptural relief. A standout statement piece for desks, coffee tables, or shelves, 3D printed with layered high-density eco-PLA for an organic tactile finish.

products.name: Marble Hour Architectural Sculpt
products.description: Minimal geometric curves and fluid architectural lines rendered in ice-white and pale grey. 3D printed with 0.16mm ultra-fine layers for a smooth, stone-like aesthetic. Perfect for modern minimalist interiors.

products.name: Dusk Architecture 3D Wall Plaque
products.description: Crisp geometric lines dissolving into twilight layered elevations. 3D printed with deep midnight navy filament with subtle matte light absorption. Commands attention in living rooms and home offices.

products.name: Sable Gardens Layered 3D Art
products.description: Moody layered floral profiles in deep organic earth tones. 3D printed with multi-layer depth transitions that capture ambient room lighting from different angles.

products.name: R350 Horizon 3D Panoramic Art
products.description: An expansive multi-depth mountain and horizon landscape. 3D printed with undulating topographic layers that give real physical relief to your wall. Lightweight and easy to hang with command strips.

products.name: Tree of Life 3D Geometric Art
products.description: An intricate depiction of the Tree of Life with interlocking branch geometry. High-detail 3D printed with gold Silk PLA, symbolizing growth, harmony, and resilience. Beautiful against wood or stone walls.

products.name: Porsche 911 GT3 – 3D Wall Silhouette
products.description: A striking rear-view silhouette of the legendary Porsche 911 GT3 with aggressive aero wing, quad exhaust styling, and precision body contours. 3D printed in matte carbon gray for automotive enthusiasts, studios, and garages.

products.name: Tactile Alphabet 3D Flashcards (26 Letters)
products.description: Sensory embossed 3D printed alphabet learning tiles. Features raised tactile letters and tactile borders in durable dual-tone eco PLA. Perfect for toddlers, early phonics learning, and Montessori sensory education.

products.name: Number & Math Tactile 3D Learning Tiles
products.description: Embossed numerals 0–9 and mathematical operators with 3D raised count dots. Helps children feel numbers physically while learning counting and simple arithmetic. Washable and durable.

products.name: Porsche 911 GT3 Silhouette 3D Keychain
products.description: Precision 3D printed GT3 profile with distinctive rear wing and aerodynamic lines. Printed in tough, impact-resistant PETG with a premium stainless steel key ring. Durable, scratch-resistant, and featherlight.

products.name: Custom Dual-Color Nameplate 3D Keychain
products.description: Personalized 3D printed keychain customized with your name, initials, or vehicle registration number. Multi-filament layered printing with raised lettering and rounded tactile edges. The ultimate gift or personal accessory.
